task_context.problem_statement: A regular hexagon with center at the origin in the complex plane has opposite pairs of sides one unit apart. One pair of sides is parallel to the imaginary axis. Let $R$ be the region outside the hexagon, and let $S = \left\lbrace\frac{1}{z} \ | \ z \in R\right\rbrace$.  Find the area of $S.$
